metadata.title: Positive cubature on $S^2$:low-degree rigidity and uniform bounds
metadata.abstract: Let \(N_t\) denote the least number of nodes in a positive cubature formula of degree \(t\) on \(S^2\). We prove that a formula of degree \(2m+1\) cannot have exactly \((m+1)(m+2)+1\) nodes for any \(m\ge2\). Excluding equality in the Fisher bound then gives \[ N_{2m+1}\ge (m+1)(m+2)+2 \] for \(m\ge3\), and known constructions yield the exact values \(N_7=22\) and \(N_9=32\). For general odd degrees, positive circle measures on Lobatto latitudes give an upper bound with quadratic coefficient \(13/8\), parity-dependent linear terms, and an \(O(m^{2/3})\) remainder. We determine the sharp constant \(49\sqrt[3]{3}/72\) for the scalar remainder in this construction. Lower bounds are obtained from continuous weighted LP--Turán inequalities and radial caps whose Helmholtz companions are nonnegative measures. We prove that the cap functional admits a maximizer at each fixed admissible support radius and derive explicit finite-degree lower bounds by a positivity-preserving transfer to the sphere.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 球面正求积的低次数刚性与统一界
analysis.workSummary: 排除 S² 上若干紧邻 Fisher 界的正求积节点数，结合已知构造得到 N₇=22、N₉=32；通过 Lobatto 纬圈正测度构造一般奇次上界，并以连续加权 LP–Turán 方法给出下界。
analysis.breakthrough: 同时改进低次数精确节点数与高次数统一渐近估计。
analysis.limitations: 正权求积不同于等权球面设计；余项尖锐常数针对文中的特定构造。
